_note: Maps each paper claim to the qtiming-bench command that produces it (plan 17.5). Commands read or write under results/<run-id>/. Status says what can be produced today; nothing here is a result.

H1.claim: Soundness: zero executor violations on PROVED / PROVED-UNDER programs, per personality
H1.status: runnable now. The prereg run (runs_per_program 1000, random_programs 10000, seeds 1,2,3) is repeated per seed. Executor-visible kinds only (O1, O2a, O5 drops); O3/O4/O7 are covered by tests/property/test_soundness.py

H2.claim: Precision: false-alarm rate against exhaustive enumeration on small programs
H2.command: qtiming-bench truth --suite benchmarks/families --out benchmarks/families/ && qtiming-bench report results/<run-id>/ --tables paper/tables/
H2.status: partial. Ground truth is per-run executor violations only and the IBM contract produces none, so the table is trivial until non-IBM contracts have gate durations (use --assume) or the truth is extended to O3/O4

H3.claim: Scalability: check time and fraction certified within the limit, windowing on and off, tier mix
H3.command: qtiming-bench run --suite benchmarks/families --contracts all --policies eq,sync,exp --repeat 5 --timeout 60 --unroll-limit 16 --out results/<run-id>/   (and again with --unroll-limit 1000000 for windowing off)
H3.status: needs the full sweep: the suite has no size-parameterised programs beyond the 1/3/20/100-round QEC series, and the scaling plot script (paper/figs) is not written

H4.claim: Portability: share of dynamic programs whose verdict differs across the four contracts
H4.status: runnable, but on the shipped contracts only IBM publishes gate durations, so 3 of 4 columns read `unsupported`; rerun with --assume durations.*=... to compare verdicts

H5.claim: Policy cost: added idle of EQ versus SYNC on QEC and RUS families
H5.status: not wired into qtiming-bench: the verdict does not yet report policy_cost

H6.claim: Hardware: inferred feedforward window and join behaviour versus the vendor 600 ns
H6.status: needs hardware evidence (IBM dry runs / QPU data, plan 18); not producible offline and not part of qtiming-bench

headline.claim: Provenance dependence: number of verdicts resting on non-certified numbers, and the placeholder count
headline.output: table headline_provenance (cells resting on a non-certified number; assumptions; placeholders)
